# `aitbc agent subscribe`

Subscribe an agent to a message topic on the coordinator.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent subscribe [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | Agent ID |
| `--topic` | text | — | yes | Topic to subscribe to |
| `--filter` | text | — | no | Filter criteria (JSON string) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet signing the subscribe request headers (default: $AITBC_DEFAULT_WALLET) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent subscribe --agent-id <agent_id> --topic <topic>
```
